problem: Judge whether the deployment evidence is sufficient.

candidates.trajectory: EXPECTED_PASS: Project, Issue, Project item, validation check, and unmerged PR all have matching readback evidence.
EXPECTED_REJECT: The agent claims success but provides no resource URLs or readback evidence.
EXPECTED_UNKNOWN: A Project URL exists, but Issue, Project item, validation, and PR evidence are missing.

criteria.name: Evidence quality
criteria.description: Prefer complete, directly reproducible evidence; reject unsupported success claims and treat missing evidence as uncertain.
